title: Satisfaction of triangular equations
statement: Let $\nu$ be a finite set and let a list of pairs $(v_i,E_i)$ consist of variables $v_i\in\nu$ and linear equations over $\mathbb F_2$. Suppose each equation has coefficient $1$ at its paired variable, and every later equation in the list has coefficient $0$ at each earlier paired variable. The assignment obtained by setting the paired variables recursively to satisfy their equations satisfies every equation in the list.
hypotheses_covered: The pivot list is triangular: each pivot coefficient is $1$ and each later equation has coefficient $0$ at earlier pivots
